findings: Several differently colored rosettes and broad paddle-like leaves share one orange pot.
A tan-brown older leaf and patchy surface marks are visible; a neighboring monkey-tail stem crosses the view.

September 20 profile update: this one planter now has three provisional foliage-group pages: pale Echeveria rosettes, coppertone-type Sedum (probable S. adolphi / S. nussbaumerianum complex), and paddle Kalanchoe (K. luciae / K. thyrsiflora complex). The pages reuse existing photos; they do not establish exact component identities, separate root systems or additional tracked pots.

Later care September 19: watered and fed, then freely detached dead lower leaves were cleaned away. This September 16 photograph predates that cleanup and does not show the current post-water appearance.

October 9 visual re-review of the historical September 16 image: pale rosettes, orange/copper leaves, broad yellow-green/red paddle leaves and a dry tan-purple lower leaf are visible. Crowding hides bases; the photograph predates the September 19 cleanup and cannot show the present cleaned condition.
